note: Working assumptions for a UK business-account provider (2026-10-30), to be replaced by a partner's real figures before publication. Stopping a good customer costs revenue: declining loses its lifetime value; reviewing costs analyst time plus the share of good applicants who abandon during review. Manual review is not perfect: analysts miss a share of bad businesses, which are then onboarded.

derivation.review/good: analyst cost + abandonment x lifetime value = 120 + 0.10 x 1000
derivation.review/bad: analyst cost + miss rate x loss from onboarding a bad business = 120 + 0.20 x 8000
derivation.decline/review: half the lifetime value: about half of cases needing review turn out to be good
